claims.claim: In the historical 2026-09-04 baseline, TypeScript, Vitest, ESLint, Expo dependency checks, and the static web export passed in the canonical workspace.
The installed and tested Android API 36 development APK is preserved as the canonical debug artifact.
A fresh native run reached Prepare, Rehearse, Quiet Coach, active recording, and Ready using the APK-matched Expo 57.0.19 JavaScript runtime.
The accepted take existed only in app-private storage and was non-empty before deletion.
Native playback entered the Pause my take state and returned to Play my take after pausing.

In the 2026-09-04 capture, the Plus surface remained preview-only and its then-labelled trial control was disabled; no purchase was available or attempted. This historical label does not establish an available trial.
After explicit confirmation, the native delete flow reached the empty state, the private audio directory was empty, and the session metadata file was absent.
The remediation run kept every numbered capture clear of the development Tools overlay and placed app content between the API 36 status and gesture areas.
Quiet Coach announces that it is playing, and active recording announces guide 0%, selects 0%, disables all guide-level controls, and states that only the user's voice is recording.
A verified private take survived an app force-stop and returned directly to Ready after the development client reconnected.
Retry required explicit replacement consent, removed the previous audio and metadata before navigation, and opened only the configured Friday clause as the primary phrase.
The focused retry produced exactly one new private take and session, then explicit deletion again left no audio file or session metadata.

The completed runs produced no AndroidRuntime, ReactNativeJS, or Expo error-channel entries and no fatal exception. Non-fatal Stagefright stop-state warnings were observed and did not prevent successful takes, recovery, replacement, or deletion.
Automatic dark mode rendered natively on Android API 36 in portrait at system font scale 1.0.
The expanded two-column rehearsal rendered natively on Android API 36 in dark landscape at system font scale 1.3 without clipping the phrase, guide controls, take action, or privacy message.
The UI-hardening build assembled and installed as an x86_64 Android API 36 test APK. It is emulator-only and is not a store artifact.
The configured app icon is 1024x1024, and a native Android API 36 emulator screenshot was captured without a device frame at the submission-requested 1179x2556 dimensions.

An x86_64 Android API 36 development build loaded the published RevenueCat paywall, completed an observed simulated Test Store annual purchase, and read back the active braveline_pro entitlement. The Test Store generated no real charge or revenue. The historical restore-success screenshot does not independently establish successful restore; the receipt records the subsequent UI-handling correction.
The 2026-09-08 receipt-handling correction passed TypeScript and 52 automated tests. These checks do not establish a fresh successful native purchase or restore.

Successful restore re-verification is pending. The previous UI could display restore success after an operation failure while retaining an already-active entitlement. A fresh device run with corrected receipt handling is required.

The existing 56-second English video is a captioned screenshot montage assembled from retained Android emulator evidence, not a continuous screen recording. It contains historical Prepare, Quiet Coach, recording, Ready, and RevenueCat paywall captures, plus the previous UI restore-success message that requires re-verification. It has no verified public URL; submission suitability and public hosting remain pending.

On 2026-09-08 the entrant confirmed active enrollment and supplied an academic email privately. GitHub readback verified the repository as public and MIT-licensed at commit 025f322. Final eligibility review belongs to the organizers; anonymous repository access verification is separate.

A submission-suitable public demo video and final Devpost submission receipt remain pending. Devpost registration was rechecked live on 2026-09-07 and was already registered; registration does not establish submission of BraveLine.
